question: Should `submitText` become a permanent channel-neutral public plugin SDK result, with Discord as a supported transport alongside the existing Telegram behavior?
rationale: The implementation is narrowly scoped and live-proven, but exporting the result establishes a durable SDK contract and support expectation across channels that cannot be settled mechanically by tests alone.

options.title: Accept the shared SDK contract
options.body: Approve `submitText` as an optional shared interactive result with documented per-channel support, then merge after ordinary current-head review.

options.title: Keep it transport-specific
options.body: Retain Telegram-only semantics and ask for a Discord-private or separately designed extension instead of expanding the shared plugin API.

options.title: Defer for SDK design
options.body: Pause the PR until plugin SDK owners define supported-channel capability discovery and long-term interaction submission semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared SDK contract
recommendation.body: Approve `submitText` as an optional shared interactive result with documented per-channel support, then merge after ordinary current-head review.

likelyOwner.reason: A concrete individual owner could not be established without the required local history pass; the decision belongs with the plugin SDK and interactive-routing ownership boundary.
